sub_graphs.title: Memory Operations Gas Costs
sub_graphs.description: Models gas calculation for memory operations including expansion costs

nodes.label: Gas Available
nodes.description: Current gas remaining in EVM execution

nodes.label: Charge GAS_VERY_LOW
nodes.description: Base gas cost for MLOAD, MSTORE, MSTORE8 operations

nodes.label: Charge GAS_BASE
nodes.description: Gas cost for MSIZE operation

nodes.label: Calculate Memory Expansion Gas
nodes.description: Use calculate_gas_extend_memory() based on accessed range and current size

nodes.label: Expansion Gas Calculated
nodes.description: Memory expansion gas cost has been computed

nodes.label: Charge Memory Expansion Gas
nodes.description: Deduct the calculated memory expansion cost

nodes.label: Charge MCOPY Gas
nodes.description: GAS_COPY * ceil(length/32) + GAS_VERY_LOW + expansion

nodes.label: Gas Successfully Charged
nodes.description: All gas costs deducted, operation can proceed

nodes.label: Out of Gas
nodes.description: Insufficient gas for operation

ambiguities.text: The specification does not explicitly define the behavior when MCOPY source and destination ranges overlap
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume MCOPY handles overlapping regions correctly (like memmove rather than memcpy), copying to a temporary buffer first. This is standard EVM behavior.

ambiguities.text: Memory addresses use unsigned 256-bit integers without explicit bounds validation documented
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume that extremely large memory addresses will fail due to out-of-gas when memory expansion costs are calculated, effectively limiting practical memory size.

implicit_assumptions.description: Memory is initialized to zero and reading uninitialized memory returns zeros
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If uninitialized memory could contain non-zero values, it could leak data from previous executions or cause non-deterministic behavior.

implicit_assumptions.description: Memory expansion is quadratic in cost, preventing unbounded memory allocation
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If memory expansion were linear or free, attackers could exhaust node memory resources with minimal gas.

implicit_assumptions.description: Memory is isolated per execution context and cannot be read/written by other contracts during execution
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Memory corruption or cross-context memory access would break contract isolation guarantees.

implicit_assumptions.description: MSTORE8 correctly masks to the lowest byte (0xFF) of the value
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If more than one byte were written, adjacent memory could be corrupted.
